data.gender_notes: Bilqisut is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bilqisut is the Arabic name for the legendary Queen of Sheba, who was renowned for her wisdom, wealth, and beauty. In Islamic tradition, she is regarded as a symbol of power, intelligence, and virtue. The name Bilqisut carries the meaning “Queen of Sheba” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bilqisut usually hope their child will grow to embody queen of sheba and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A sign of wisdom, leadership, and strength in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Bilqisut belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Queen of Sheba.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bilqisut total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

Her name has been passed down through generations as an example of leadership, intelligence, and wealth. In popular culture, she has been featured in various stories and works of art, representing the strength and resilience of women in history.

Her great intelligence and wisdom are often highlighted, emphasizing the importance of knowledge and learning in Islam. Her story serves as a reminder of the power of faith and the transformative effect it can have on one's life.
